cases.explain: Истина is the predicate noun after the linking verb есть ('is'), so it stands in the nominative case.

cases.sentence: И сейчас, Отец, прославь меня у Тебя самого той славой, которую я имел у Тебя еще до начала существования ___.
cases.explain: The preposition до ('before, until') governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Закончив говорить, Иисус поднял глаза к ___ и сказал.
cases.explain: The preposition к ('toward') governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Я прославил Тебя на земле, совершив ___, которую Ты мне поручил.
cases.explain: Работу is the direct object of совершив ('having accomplished'), so it takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: И сейчас, Отец, прославь меня у Тебя самого той ___, которую я имел у Тебя еще до начала существования мира.
cases.explain: The verb прославь ('glorify') here takes its instrument in the instrumental case, expressing 'with that glory'.

cases.sentence: Ведь вечная жизнь состоит в ___ Тебя, единственного истинного Бога и Иисуса Христа, которого Ты послал.
cases.explain: The preposition в ('in') governs the prepositional case.

reading.ru: Прославь твоего сына, чтобы сын мог прославить тебя.
reading.question: What does Jesus ask the Father to do at the start of his prayer?
options: Glorify his Son so the Son may glorify the Father
Send more disciples into the world
reading.correct: Glorify his Son so the Son may glorify the Father
reading.explain: Jesus asks the Father to glorify the Son, so that the Son may glorify the Father.

reading.ru: Ведь вечная жизнь состоит в познании Тебя, единственного истинного Бога и Иисуса Христа, которого Ты послал.
reading.question: How does Jesus define eternal life?
options: Knowing the only true God and Jesus Christ, whom God sent
reading.correct: Knowing the only true God and Jesus Christ, whom God sent
reading.explain: Jesus says eternal life consists in knowing the only true God and Jesus Christ whom he sent.

reading.ru: Я открыл твое имя тем, кого ты взял из мира и дал Мне.
reading.question: What does Jesus say he has done for those the Father gave him?
options: Revealed the Father's name to them
reading.correct: Revealed the Father's name to them
reading.explain: Jesus says he has revealed the Father's name to those the Father gave him out of the world.

reading.ru: Святой Отец, сохрани их во имя Твое, имя, которое Ты дал мне, чтобы они были одно, как и мы с Тобой одно.
reading.question: What does Jesus ask the Father to do for his disciples?
options: Keep them in the Father's name so that they may be one
Send them back to the wilderness
Make them rulers over the Gentiles
reading.correct: Keep them in the Father's name so that they may be one
reading.explain: Jesus prays that the Father keep them in his name so that they may be one, as he and the Father are one.

reading.ru: Я охранял их, и никто из них не погиб, кроме осужденного на погибель, чтобы исполнилось Писание.
reading.question: What does Jesus say happened to the one who was lost among his disciples?
options: He was destined for destruction so that Scripture would be fulfilled
He escaped and was never found again
He became the greatest of the disciples
reading.correct: He was destined for destruction so that Scripture would be fulfilled
reading.explain: Jesus says none of them was lost except the one destined for destruction, so that Scripture would be fulfilled.

reading.ru: Освяти их твоей истиной. Твое слово есть истина.
reading.question: What does Jesus ask the Father to do with his disciples' truth?
options: Sanctify them by the Father's truth, which is his word
Give them a new law to follow
reading.correct: Sanctify them by the Father's truth, which is his word
reading.explain: Jesus asks the Father to sanctify them by his truth, declaring that the Father's word is truth.

reading.ru: Я молюсь не только о них, но и о тех, кто поверит в меня по их слову, чтобы все они были одно.
reading.question: Who else does Jesus pray for besides his current disciples?
options: Future believers who will believe through the disciples' word
reading.correct: Future believers who will believe through the disciples' word
reading.explain: Jesus prays also for those who will believe in him through the disciples' word.

reading.ru: Праведный Отец, хотя мир не знает Тебя, но я знаю Тебя, и мои последователи знают, что Ты послал меня.
reading.question: What does Jesus say about the world's knowledge of the Father compared to his followers'?
options: The world does not know the Father, but Jesus and his followers do
The world knows the Father better than the disciples do
No one knows the Father, including Jesus
Only the Pharisees know the Father
reading.correct: The world does not know the Father, but Jesus and his followers do
reading.explain: Jesus says the world does not know the righteous Father, but he knows him and his followers know God sent him.
